design_philosophy: Premium, Trustworthy, Analytical, Modern, Financial-report style. A regulated financial research platform applied to higher education.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Swiss Grid, High Density for Data, Ample Spacing for Marketing.

surface_strategies.cards: bg-surface border border-border rounded-none sm:rounded-md shadow-sm
surface_strategies.factsheet: border-collapse style layout, visible grid lines separating metrics, minimalist.
surface_strategies.inputs: bg-transparent border-b border-border rounded-none focus:ring-0 focus:border-primary

motion_and_interactions.animations: Subtle stagger on list items, smooth scroll for navigation.

hero_background.description: Animated intelligence dashboard background with floating cards showing Outcome Scores, Transparency Ratings, Placement Trends, and ROI Metrics.

image_urls.description: Abstract data visualization for Insight Engine background or deep tech sections.

component_instructions.hero: Hero section must feature a bold, text-heavy value proposition on the left (Make One Of Life's Biggest Investments With Better Data) and an animated, abstract dashboard UI on the right.
component_instructions.decision_gap_story: Interactive visual story. Side-by-side comparison of 'Advertised' vs 'Actual Filings'. Use strict, neutral terminology. No accusatory language.
component_instructions.market_landscape: Large, interactive Recharts scatter plot. X=Total Cost, Y=Median Graduate Outcome. Bubble size=Student Strength, Bubble color (Primary vs Positive vs Warning)=Transparency Rating.
component_instructions.intelligence_categories: Bento grid of 6 cards. High-contrast typography. Each card highlights a specific metric (Best ROI, Strongest Outcomes, etc.).
component_instructions.factsheet_preview: Design like a Morningstar mutual fund factsheet. Dense, multi-column grid, highly structured. Include source badges (Government Filing, Accreditation Report).
component_instructions.disclosure_comparison: Table format. Left column: Advertised Information. Right column: Regulatory Disclosure. Status badge: Variance Indicator (Low/Moderate/High).
component_instructions.comparison_engine: Side-by-side data table comparing up to 4 institutions. Lock the first column (metrics).
component_instructions.insight_engine: AI-generated observation panel. Use monospace font for the 'AI generation' effect. Financial-research-style text.
component_instructions.methodology: Footer-adjacent section with a transparent breakdown of data sources (NIRF, NAAC, etc.) and buttons to view methodology.
component_instructions.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the color palette. Do NOT introduce new colors. Use Tailwind arbitrary values if necessary.
Ensure the UI feels like a Bloomberg terminal or Morningstar report, NOT a flashy consumer app.
Use Recharts for all data visualizations (Scatter Plot, Bar Charts).
Build the Factsheet page and Comparison page as distinct, high-fidelity views.
Avoid typical card shadows. Rely on 1px borders and typography for hierarchy.
